earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/akronim at 9288ae0636d38a5b42002d6df8b5906c49fe9b1a: a build of the font dumped to TTX, and its metadata; no source.
disclose: The release kerns with a legacy `kern` table (1051 pairs) and has no GPOS; these sources kern through a GPOS kern feature, which is how fontc builds kerning. HarfBuzz shapes every kerned pair alike in both (the functional gate). Decided 2026-10-01: releases with an old kern table are accepted and disclosed.

The released font is partly hinted (TrueType instructions in 16 of its 254 glyphs). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
